retrievalProfile.description: A dark, low-key diorama featuring tactile claymation figures on a stage with bold, heavy-weight sans-serif typography at the top.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, atmospheric scene depicting two clay-sculpted figures performing on a stage with a drum kit, viewed from the perspective of a clay-sculpted audience. The lighting is dramatic and directional, highlighting the fingerprints and rough textures of the clay. The top third of the composition is reserved for high-contrast, heavy-weight block typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Tactile clay figures against a dark, shadowy background
Large-scale header text dominating the upper horizontal band
Foreground audience silhouettes framing the mid-ground stage action
High-contrast color split in the main title text
coreInvariants: Visible clay fingerprints and sculpting marks on all characters

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central clay figures at mid-scale, positioned left and right of a central drum kit.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, two-tone title text at the top of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold title at the top, down to the illuminated clay performers, then to the dark audience silhouettes at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark negative space in the upper mid-section and background to create depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for secondary text and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for primary title emphasis.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value highlights on the clay surfaces and high-saturation red in the typography.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic weight variation of a single heavy sans-serif family.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory style badge in corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and high-impact feel of the display text.
Provides the necessary verticality and tight spacing.
A modern web-safe alternative with similar proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark, low-key diorama scene featuring two clay-sculpted figures on a stage with a drum kit. The figures should have visible fingerprints and a tactile, handmade quality. The foreground should show the silhouettes of a clay audience. Leave the top 30% of the image as dark, empty space for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add heavy, condensed uppercase sans-serif text in the top third. The main title should be split into two colors: bright red for the first half and white for the second. Add secondary artist names below in smaller bold sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the clay texture visible on the figures?
Is the lighting low-key and dramatic?
Is the typography heavy, condensed, and uppercase?
Is the top title split between red and white?

postGenerationChecks: Check for fingerprint textures on clay surfaces
Ensure the foreground audience is silhouetted
Confirm the red/white color split in the header
Check for a dark, moody atmosphere
recipe.reuseFormula: Tactile Claymation + Low-Key Stage Lighting + Heavy Condensed Sans-Serif Typography
